answer: Randomized Wharf Assignment. Each epoch, agents draw a verifiable random seed (VRF) that maps them to a wharf duty slot; only agents holding a valid slot may transact that tide. Duplicates can't predict seeds before committing, so a sybil cluster wins at most its proportional share of slots. Each extra identity costs a full VRF beacon request plus a falcon-signed enrollment receipt, priced per request.
